name: Cashmere Body Mist, Vanilla Cashmere (6 fl oz)
editorialDescription: A vanilla-scented body mist from eos's Cashmere line. The listed ingredients start with denatured alcohol, water and fragrance, followed by glycerin, sodium hyaluronate (a form of hyaluronic acid) and aloe leaf juice. It's an inexpensive way to add a light scent, but it isn't a replacement for a moisturizer.
keyFeatures: Ingredients include alcohol denat., water, fragrance, glycerin, sodium hyaluronate and aloe leaf juice (per retailer ingredient lists)
eos describes it as vegan and cruelty-free
advantages: A large bottle for casual, all-over use
disadvantages: Alcohol is the first ingredient, which some people with dry or sensitive skin prefer to avoid
Body mists are generally lighter than perfume, so expect to reapply
suits: People who like vanilla scents and want something light for everyday use
Anyone who prefers a low-commitment scent over a full perfume
skipIf: You react to fragranced products; FDA notes fragrance ingredients may be listed only as "fragrance" on U.S. labels
You need real moisture for very dry skin; use a moisturizer
buyingConsiderations: Check the scent name (the Cashmere line has several)
Check the ingredient list on the listing matches the current formula
Patch-test before spraying widely if your skin is sensitive
